facts.fact: Ask the recruiting agent to show the original Registration Certificate issued by the Protector General of Emigrants (MEA)
facts.quote: Ask him to show his Original Registration Certificate issued by the Protector General of Emigrants, Govt. of India.

facts.fact: The agent's registration can be checked on MEA's eMigrate portal (emigrate.gov.in) through 'Find Recruiting Agent'
facts.quote: Quick Links Recruiting agent registration Find Recruiting Agent Details of PDOT Centers

facts.fact: If in doubt, check with an office of the Protector of Emigrants (POE) or the Protector General of Emigrants (PGE)
facts.quote: In case of doubt, check with any of the offices of the Protector of Emigrants (POEs) or the Protector General of Emigrants (PGE).

facts.fact: Do not deal with sub-agents: they are not permitted under the Emigration Act, 1983
facts.quote: Do not deal with sub-agents as they are not permitted under the Emigration Act, 1983 and Rules.

behaviour: Uses only MEA guidance (mea.gov.in / emigrate.gov.in) on registered recruiting agents and emigration; warns about illegal agents and sub-agents; no third-party sites.
fail_if: Cites third-party or private recruitment sites; says any agent can be trusted without checking registration; gives invented helplines.
summary: Added MEA guidance: check the agent's PGE registration certificate and on eMigrate, ask POE/PGE if in doubt, avoid sub-agents.
